html:
The Yukuna, who call themselves Kamejeya, are an Arawakan people of the Mirití-Paraná river in the Amazonas department of Colombia.

They live in longhouses, grow manioc and hunt and fish, and share ceremonies and marriage ties with the Tanimuka and other neighbours. The Makuna live to the north. In the early 1900s rubber traders of the rubber boom enslaved many people of the region. Little else about their history before the 1900s is written down.
sum: The Yukuna, who call themselves Kamejeya, are an Arawakan people of the Mirití-Paraná river in the Amazonas department of Colombia.
